pointDefinition: Visible underside heel/sole contact of the leading foot, manually read on this identity source and checked against own alpha/skin contour. Not the trailing toe or the whole-alpha bounding-box bottom.
precisionNote: Manual source-grid inspection; approximately two native pixels, not optical foot tracking.

rear/00-contact.review: Far right leading heel is partly occluded; selected its visible underside edge, not the nearer trailing sole.

rear/04-opposite-contact.review: Far left leading heel underside at the right/proximal end of the forward foot.

rearRight/00-contact.review: Leading right heel underside in the upper-right forward foot; trailing near toes are excluded.

rearRight/04-opposite-contact.review: Leading left heel underside of upper-right forward foot; near lower-left foot trails.
